# ⚡ FastAPI LLM Microservice

A high-performance, asynchronous FastAPI microservice designed for integrating Large Language Model (LLM) workflows into enterprise backend systems.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Asynchronous Endpoints:** High-throughput async routing built for low-latency AI responses.
* **Strict Request Validation:** Powered by Pydantic models for bulletproof JSON schema enforcement.
* **Auto-Generated OpenAPI Docs:** Live Swagger UI & Redoc API documentation available out of the box.
* **Structured Error Handling:** Graceful retry mechanics and exception handling for upstream API timeouts.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack
* **Framework:** FastAPI
* **Server:** Uvicorn
* **Data Validation:** Pydantic
* **Language:** Python

## 🚀 Quick Start
```bash
git clone [https://github.com/afshinjan4466-png/FastAPI-LLM-Microservice.git](https://github.com/afshinjan4466-png/FastAPI-LLM-Microservice.git)
cd FastAPI-LLM-Microservice
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
